CustomField.description: Optional Salesforce formula returning true or false, evaluated on the email's record (Record Id) by EmailService (Formula.builder). Empty: the rule always applies. Fields are written as in a formula field of the record's object, relationships allowed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. A formula on the email's record, true when this recipient must receive the email, e.g. ISPICKVAL(DataSensitivity__c, "Confidential"). Leave empty to always send to this recipient.
CustomField.label: Condition
